bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 71; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:candidate-2192d3c)" || exit 72; q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; cnt=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(49,104) t(id) JOIN posting_topics p ON p.message_thread_id=t.id AND p.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND p.board_key='area_bbs' AND p.purpose='announcement' AND p.enabled=TRUE AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.verified_by IS NOT NULL JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins d ON d.chat_id=p.chat_id AND d.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND d.state='published' AND d.pinned=TRUE AND d.message_id>0 AND d.token_hash IS NOT NULL") || exit 73; test "$cnt" = 56 || exit 74; unique=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT p.message_thread_id FROM posting_topics p WHERE p.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND p.board_key='area_bbs' AND p.purpose='announcement' AND p.message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 GROUP BY p.message_thread_id HAVING count(*)=1) x") || exit 75; test "$unique" = 56 || exit 76; valid=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins d WHERE d.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND d.message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND d.state IN ('needs_reconcile','publishing')") || exit 77; test "$valid" = 0 || exit 78
